short_description.value: AlphaEarth Foundations (AEF) is an embedding field model for geospatial representation learning, enabling accurate and efficient global mapping from sparse label data. It produces annual, global, analysis-ready embedding field layers at 10m spatial resolution, supporting multi-source, multi-modal, and time-continuous inputs.

pretext_training_type.value: Self-supervised contrastive learning with reconstruction, batch uniformity, consistency, and text contrastive objectives

masking_strategy.value: Random dropping of input sources and time-steps during training; no input masking at inference

pretraining.value: AEF is trained on over 3 billion observations from 2017-2023, across 8,412,511 video sequences from 5,145,244 unique sites, using multi-source raster and text data. Training uses a teacher-student model with contrastive and reconstruction losses, batch uniformity, and text alignment.

value.value: Simultaneous space, time, and precision operators

dataset.value: Multi-source: Sentinel-2 L1C, Landsat-8/9 L1C, Sentinel-1 GRD, ALOS PALSAR-2, GEDI L2A, Copernicus DEM GLO-30, ERA5-Land, GRACE, NLCD, Wikipedia, GBIF

learning_rate.value: piecewise linear: 0 to 1e-4 over 1e3 steps, then 1e-4 to 0 over 1e5 steps

sampling.value: Stratified by ecoregion, gridded text, coral, intertidal; 1.28km minimum spacing; two non-overlapping periods per site

processing_level.value: Sentinel-2 L1C, Landsat-8/9 L1C, Sentinel-1 GRD, ALOS PALSAR-2 Level 2.2

cloud_cover.value: Cloud Score+ (Sentinel-2), FMASK (Landsat); masks used for training only

missing_data.value: Masked pixels excluded from loss; missing frames replaced with masks; Antarctica excluded due to insufficient Sentinel-1
